name: Sadaakira
source:
Hobby: Cleaning

Although he seems unfriendly, he is actually good at taking care of others and has a high moral standard for himself. He is, surprisingly, a tidy person and is always doing cleaning in free time.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
